desc:
Climb all 10 floors of the Rita Kitcat Tower! 💗🌈

🏃 Climb the stairs and pass the Tower Obby stage
👑 Escape from the giant brother on each floor
💚 Use Safe Zones to hide and rest along the way
🌈 Conquer the 10th Floor Rainbow Stage
📸 Once you complete it, unlock the Super Fan photo corner
👕 Check out the Rita Kitcat merchandise at the starting point

If Rita catches you, you'll have to start over!
Can you escape from Rita and reach the 10th floor? 💕
